output.summary: A perennial herb native through most of Europe and western Asia, typically growing in damp meadows. Its divided leaves are dark green above and whitish beneath, while its numerous creamy-white summer flowers have a strong sweet scent and are used to flavour drinks, fruit, jams and desserts.
output.edibilityNote: Flowers flavour stewed fruit, jams and desserts; the aromatic plant also flavours vinegar, wine, beer and Scandinavian mead.
